update.changes: JEM 5.1.0 beta 1 introduces the Essential and Advanced Events & Venues operating profiles. Advanced adds programmes, venue hierarchies, reusable Venue Profiles, Spaces, versioned Layouts, Capacity Areas, immutable event allocation snapshots, overlap control and capacity-only registrations, with consistent location output across web, PDF, ICS and notifications. Event Details now provides one authoritative, profile-independent Schema.org Event JSON-LD entity from the event's effective public data; incomplete Event Microdata and Offers were removed from detail, list, calendar and module output. Commerce & Ticketing remains visible as a planned future profile but cannot be activated in this release.
